import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static long[] mul = new long[100];
    static int n;
    static long ans = Long.MAX_VALUE;

    static void dfs(int now, long num, int opt) {
        if (num == 0) {
            if (opt < ans) {
                ans = opt;
            }
            return;
        }
        if (now == -1) {
            return;
        }
        int i;
        for (i = -10; i * mul[now] <= num; i++);
        dfs(now - 1, num - (long) (i - 1) * mul[now], opt + Math.abs(i - 1) * (now + 1));
        dfs(now - 1, num - i * mul[now], opt + Math.abs(i) * (now + 1));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        long num = scanner.nextLong();
        mul[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 18; i++) {
            mul[i] = mul[i - 1] * 10;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= 18; i++) {
            mul[i] += mul[i - 1];
        }
        for (n = 1; n <= 18 && mul[n] <= num; n++);
        dfs(n, num, 0);
        System.out.println(ans);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
